assessments.evidence: The current Premier aggregate lists Cloud Platform 10.2.x+ and ES 8.6+; the task guide sets Cloud ES 8.7+ with paired SOAR and enabled assistant. The 8.7 task preserves the earlier AI SOC analyst name and ES 8.7+ floor. The current 8.8 task requires existing findings, at least one triaged finding in the investigation, first ten results for a single detection burst, approximately 200 findings per tenant per day, frontier models, inherited connector permissions, and the additional granular asset role. CMP requires Platform 10.4+, ES 8.8+, Cloud Connect 2.0+ and separately documented SAIA 2.4+. The CMP setup prerequisites were assessed from indexed official text after direct 404. SAIA 2.3.6 excludes Cloud Connected, the 2.1.1 fallback lacks Agent Mode, and 2.4.0 is planned. The ES 8.8.0 November 4 GA milestone and edition/region pages establish neither a compatible exact pair nor per-agent rollout, entitlement or customer authorization.
